'''Pol pollen''' was an addictive [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] that could be purchased in a tube form, and was inhaled through the nose. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Slyder]] was addicted to pol pollen, and ended up devoting more and more of his [[Currency/Legends|income]] to his addiction as he lived on the luxury [[Cruiser/Legends|cruise]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Star of Empire]]''. Slyder believed that the drug gave him a heightened ability to reason. Whenever he believed that he had a moment of brilliance, he would reward himself with a dose of the pollen.<ref name="SotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pol pollen first appeared in the [[1997]] novella ''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]'', written by [[William C. Dietz]].
